title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: One cue at a time
hook: After a swing, how many corrections do you give?
intro: You list four things to fix before the next one.
statement: Most kids can hold one cue, not four.
q1: Do you pick the one fix that matters most —
q2: or name everything while it is fresh?
q3: What does the player remember on the next rep?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But players improve
t2: when they know the one thing to try next.
cta: Coaches — how many cues do you give?
ctaLines: One cue. One swing. Then the next cue.
Fix the biggest thing or the first thing?
ctaPrompt: Share your coaching habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
After a swing, how many corrections do you give?
A player finishes a swing. You list four things to fix before the next one.
Most kids can hold one cue, not four.
Pick the one that matters most, or name everything while it is fresh. There is no perfect answer.
How many cues do you give? Share your habit in the comments.
